gameplay-l7.note: Direct-write game. No solenoid moves in 20 s of attract mode with three balls on the ball ramp. Start resets the T drop target (5) and the 3-bank (6), lowers the post (8), sets 23, and serves with the ball-ramp release (2). Specials follow PinMAME's switch table. Holding 82 sets 41 and 45/46; holding 84 sets 47/48 and leaves 41 at 0. The right outlane rollover energizes the gate (13), which stays held until the 3-bank is completed; completing the 3-bank resets it (6). The ramp bull's-eye after the T target resets the T drop target (5). A ball resting in either eject hole (16, 24) is locked and the ROM serves the next ball (2) with the space (9), shuttle (10) and insert (14) flash lamps. With both locked, the long-ramp shot (32) raises the post (7) and starts multi-ball: the left eject (3) fires at once and the right eject (4) about 3 s later. The left return lane lowers the post (8). Each outhole closure kicks 1, and after all three balls drain the ROM serves ball 2. Two playfield-tilt closures warn; the third tilts, dropping 23 and turning the GI off with 11. No output the manual prints Not Used (12, 22) moves.

solenoid-test-l7.limitation: The manual's procedure says the display sequences 01 through 25 and that sub-test 25 de-energizes the flipper relay; this ROM steps 01-16 only, so the test does not exercise the game-on enable 23.
